subject: Finalizing AP channel: portal vs multi-recipient email + VAT invoice fields
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nuvohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Finalizing AP channel: portal vs multi-recipient email + VAT invoice fields

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. To finalize the billing handoff, we need to pick a primary delivery channel and confirm the exact VAT/invoice fields you require so our billing system generates compliant VAT invoices each month. Two options we support:

1) Redwood Billing Portal (recommended)
   - You get a central repository (PDF/XML) and machine-readable invoices.
   - We can add multiple users with viewer-only access.
   - Option to push e-invoices via SFTP or AP webhook.

2) Direct email delivery (PDF) to AP recipients
   - We can send a monthly PDF to up to 5 addresses (or a distribution alias).
   - Simpler for teams using email-based AP workflows.

Quick questions so we can set this up today:
- Which channel do you prefer (portal w/ SFTP push / portal only / email PDF to addresses)?
- Billing contact(s) to add to portal or include on emails (name + email + phone).
- Company name exactly as it should appear on the VAT invoice.
- Legal company reg / VAT number and (if EU) EORI if required for your accounting.
- Remit-to bank details (IBAN/BIC) or confirmation that you accept net30 ACH / SEPA.
- Will you provide a PO number on every invoice? If yes, should we require the PO to be included in the invoice subject/body?

I attached a short invoice schema and an AP sample request file to show the fields we can populate.

[attachment: invoice_schema_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[attachment: Nuvo_AP-req.xml (application/xml)]

If you prefer, we can enable both: email copies to AP plus portal access for your finance ops. That keeps the human workflow intact while giving your auditors access to the canonical files.

Thanks — please ping back with the preferred channel and the VAT/company details and we'll finalize the onboarding config.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Finalizing AP channel: portal vs multi-recipient email + VAT invoice fields

Hi Grace — thanks, this is helpful.

Short version: our AP prefers a monthly PDF emailed to our AP distribution list and an optional portal copy for auditors. We do NOT have an SFTP ingestion capability right now.

Details you asked for:
- Channel: Email PDF to ap@nuvohealth.com, cc: accounts@nuvohealth.com and finance-ops@nuvohealth.com. Portal access is fine for read-only.
- Billing contact for onboarding: Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@nuvohealth.com>, +44 20 7123 4455. Please add her to portal and to the monthly send.
- Legal name: NuvoHealth Limited
- VAT number: GB123456789
- EORI: GB123456789000
- Remit: SEPA transfers preferred. IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819; BIC: NWBKGB2L
- PO: We will supply a PO on the first invoice for setup (PO #NUV-2028-001). After that, PO will be included on a best-effort basis.

Attached is our AP file format sample — we use a three-field PO matcher.

[attachment: Nuvo_AP-req.xml (application/xml)]

Two more notes:
- Can you include Company Reg Number on the invoice line item header for our auditors?
- Please include the VAT breakdown per line (taxable amount + VAT amount).

Otherwise we're fine to proceed with monthly PDF copies + portal read-only.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance Operations, NuvoHealth Ltd.
liam.oconnor@nuvohealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>

Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Finalizing AP channel: portal vs multi-recipient email + VAT invoice fields

Hi Liam — Ben here on Platform Ops. We'll take care of the portal user and the PDF routing. A couple of operational clarifications so the first invoice isn't delayed: 

- We'll add Sofia Mendes as a Viewer in the portal and add the three emails you listed to the monthly send. Expect the first auto-send on the 1st of the next billing month unless you want a different cadence.
- We will include the Company Reg Number (NuvoHealth Limited) and a VAT breakdown per line item. Invoice PDF will show subtotal, VAT (percentage), and VAT amount per line.
- PO handling: we can place the PO number in the invoice reference field and in the PDF subject line (e.g., Redwood Invoice — INV-12345 — PO: NUV-2028-001). If you might omit the PO later, we'll still send the invoice and allow your AP to match client-side.
- Bank details: we'll include our bank information on the PDF, but for SEPA you should be able to pay using the IBAN you provided to your bank referencing the invoice number.

Action items for me (so you can track):
1) Create portal user and add email send list (due Fri 22 Jun).
2) Validate invoice template includes Reg # and VAT breakdown (in progress).
3) Kick off first-month manual invoice to include PO # you provided (NUV-2028-001) and copy to your AP addresses for confirmation.

I'll attach the invoice template PDF preview once step 2 is complete.

Thanks —
Ben

- Sofia Mendes added as portal Viewer so your team can pull historical invoices for audits.
- Invoices will contain: NuvoHealth Limited (legal name), Company Reg #, VAT number (GB123456789), EORI, per-line VAT breakdown, and invoice reference that can include PO when provided.

Ben will send a one-off manual invoice for setup that includes PO NUV-2028-001 so your AP can validate matching rules. Expect Ben's preview PDF later today.
